requirements.Title: AI Productivity, Scan Workflow & Manageability Solutions
requirements.Description: Implement advanced AI-driven productivity features, scan workflows, and manageability solutions that simplify business operations for SMB customers. These should automate routine tasks, optimize document workflows, and provide intuitive management for non-IT users.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs lack dedicated IT staff and require tools that automate and streamline printing and scanning processes, reducing manual intervention and improving efficiency.
requirements.Dependencies: Integration with SMB portal, AI solution stack, device firmware.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: 1. AI-driven workflows demonstrably reduce manual steps by at least 30%. 2. User testing with non-IT staff shows >80% satisfaction. 3. All features accessible via consolidated SMB portal.

requirements.Title: Lowest Business Total Cost of Ownership (TCO)
requirements.Description: Design the Magellan printer to deliver the lowest TCO in HP's business printer portfolio, including minimized intervention, reduced consumable costs, and optimized energy consumption.
requirements.Rationale: Cost efficiency is a primary decision factor for SMBs. Lower TCO enhances competitiveness and drives adoption.
requirements.Dependencies: Keyed bottles, efficient print engine, energy-saving modes.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: 1. Independent testing verifies TCO is lowest among HP business printers. 2. Consumable and maintenance costs are at least 10% lower than previous models.

requirements.Title: Customer Replaceable Maintenance Box
requirements.Description: Introduce a replaceable maintenance box that end-users can easily replace without technician intervention, minimizing downtime and service costs.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces service calls and printer downtime for SMBs without dedicated IT support.
requirements.Dependencies: Design of maintenance box, user documentation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: 1. Maintenance box can be replaced by >95% of users in under 5 minutes (usability test). 2. No tools required for replacement.

requirements.Title: Keyed Ink Bottles
requirements.Description: Implement keyed ink bottles to prevent incorrect refilling and ensure only genuine HP supplies are used.
requirements.Rationale: Prevents user error and supports HP's supplies business model.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: 1. Only correct bottles fit into respective tanks. 2. 0% misfill rate in field trials.

requirements.Title: SMB Portal for Device Management
requirements.Description: Provide a consolidated, cloud-based SMB portal for managing multiple printers, tailored for unmanaged/lightly managed SMBs. The portal must support device setup, monitoring, troubleshooting, and reporting.
requirements.Rationale: Centralizes management for office managers and non-IT staff, improving efficiency and reducing support burden.
requirements.Dependencies: Device telemetry, cloud infrastructure, security compliance.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: 1. Portal supports management of at least 15 printers per account. 2. >90% of core management features accessible remotely. 3. Meets HP security and privacy standards.

requirements.Title: PaaS (Printing as a Service) Support
requirements.Description: Enable support for Printing as a Service (PaaS) business models, allowing subscription-based printing and remote management.
requirements.Rationale: Aligns with HP's strategic shift towards service-based offerings and recurring revenue.
requirements.Dependencies: Integration with HP PaaS platform, billing systems.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: 1. Printer can be enrolled and managed via HP PaaS platform. 2. Subscription features function as specified in HP's PaaS requirements.

requirements.Title: Speed and PDL/PS Support
requirements.Description: For PDL SKUs, achieve print speeds of 25/20 ppm (improved from current 25/19) and support PDL/PS (Page Description Language/PostScript).
requirements.Rationale: Meets the performance and compatibility needs of higher-end SMB customers and competitive benchmarks.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: 1. Independent testing confirms 25/20 ppm speed. 2. Full compatibility with PDL/PS workflows.

requirements.Title: Blue Angel Certification
requirements.Description: Obtain Blue Angel environmental certification for PDL SKUs, demonstrating compliance with recognized sustainability standards.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses customer and regulatory demand for sustainable office products, enhancing marketability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: 1. Blue Angel certification achieved prior to launch. 2. Certification details published on product documentation.

requirements.Title: Warranty and Serviceability
requirements.Description: Offer an 80,000 page or 2-year warranty (whichever comes first) and ensure serviceability via PHA (customer replaceable parts) and MINK at service centers.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces total cost of ownership and increases customer confidence in product reliability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: 1. Warranty terms clearly stated in all regions. 2. >90% of common service issues resolvable by customer or at service center within 2 business days.

requirements.Title: High Recycled Content Plastic (RCP)
requirements.Description: Use at least 60% Recycled Content Plastic (RCP) in the device's construction, exceeding competitor benchmarks (Epson 30%, Canon TBC).
requirements.Rationale: Demonstrates HP's commitment to sustainability and provides a competitive differentiator.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: 1. Independent audit confirms >60% RCP in final product. 2. Marketing materials highlight sustainability achievement.

requirements.Title: Perfect Print and Perfect Scan AI Solutions
requirements.Description: Integrate AI-powered 'Perfect Print' and 'Perfect Scan' features that optimize output quality and automate error correction for common print/scan issues.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses SMB need for high-quality, error-free output without technical intervention.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: 1. Print/scan error rates reduced by >25% in field tests. 2. User satisfaction with output quality exceeds 85%.

requirements.Title: Mobile Printing via HP App
requirements.Description: Enable seamless mobile printing from smartphones and tablets using the HP App, supporting both iOS and Android platforms.
requirements.Rationale: Supports modern SMB workstyles and BYOD environments, increasing product appeal and usability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: 1. Mobile print jobs complete successfully from iOS/Android in >98% of cases. 2. Setup process for mobile printing takes <3 minutes.

requirements.Title: Advanced Telemetry Requirements
requirements.Description: Implement advanced telemetry features for remote diagnostics, usage analytics, and proactive support, accessible via the SMB portal.
requirements.Rationale: Enables efficient fleet management and predictive maintenance for SMBs, reducing downtime and support costs.
requirements.Dependencies: Device firmware, portal integration, privacy compliance.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: 1. Telemetry data is updated in real-time for all managed printers. 2. Data privacy standards are met (GDPR, etc.).
